svg.text: The skill, the guide and check teach the cheaper flow
Nothing new blocks: accepting stays explicit, and existing commands and JSON fields keep working.

g.text: Review fast path step 8: refresh-coverage after a push,
then accept proposals after reading their diffs.
Workflow: reconcile leads with what the change made
stale; leave older debt to an upkeep pass.
diagrams.md and integration.md: the repair loop,
Start from what this change made stale; proposed
ranges and their refusals; accept or revise;
keeping a review deck current; the changelog entry.
check --covers review agrees with status for a rewritten review
A HEAD-following review whose evidence was amended, rebased or squashed away used to get "no review follows HEAD; create one".
Now the area note says, like status: "pr-d follows HEAD, but none of its evidence is in this change ...; if it is this
change's review, pin it: change-saga review follow --review pr-d --head feature/d". The branch is read once and shared.
